title: Sharp local sparsity of regularized optimal transport
summary: In recent years, the use of entropy-regularized optimal transport with $L^p$-type entropies has become increasingly popular. In this setting, the solutions are sparse, in the sense that the support of the regularized optimal coupling, $\mathrm{supp}(π_\varepsilon)$, shrinks to the support of the original optimal transport problem as $\varepsilon \to 0$. The main open question concerns the rate of this convergence. In this paper, we obtain sharp local results away from the boundary.
